registry_binding.qualification: Inverse biocatalyst-sequence design subtype, not general small-molecule catalyst generation. Only ARNLD curated campaigns with explicit finite nonnegative TTN/reaction-activity-percent labels and qualified parent/variant sequence context. All DMSDB and LLMDB rows excluded. Desired response is an explicit design goal, not an outcome-prediction input. Each native variant is a demonstrated solution rather than the only correct output. Oracle values exist only for exact observed variant/context/endpoint tuples; unseen generated sequences require experiments and receive no fabricated response. Activity-percent is retained as reported, not automatically equated with isolated yield. Views overlap the mutation-effect source rows.
registry_binding.reference_evidence: Native explicit catalytic endpoint from the CC-BY-4.0 EnzEngDB experiment member, with source row ID and parent reference inherited from qualified mutation view.
